published_ranges._notes: Values from Polymaker's own Fiberon ASA-CF08 TDS V1.0. Identity: Fiberon is a Polymaker trademark and the Micro Center listing (0.5 kg, Light Gray) matches Polymaker's spool size, colour and printed values (260-280 / 90-100, HDT 103C @0.45MPa), so this is Polymaker Fiberon ASA-CF08 sold under Micro Center's Inland listing - inferred, not confirmed against the live microcenter.com page (403). Shop page gives density 1.094 and drying can drop to 70C in an airflow dryer. Retraction 1-3 mm at 20-40 mm/s (direct drive, shop page). Bambu parent not confirmed (a Polymaker Fiberon preset may exist in Bambu Studio). Colours not listed because the Inland colour range could not be read.
